predictions.limitations: The excerpt contains a preselected subset of the deposition used in the preceding study. Its coordinate rows test agreement only at those positions.

exploratory_claims.scope: All mapped residues of the supplied Top7 specimen, assessed with the fresh prediction and the frozen chain A reference excerpt.
exploratory_claims.criteria: Compute the fit over positive-occupancy Cα pairs and check their residue identities against the map. Retain every mapped position in the coverage denominator. A full-specimen Cα RMSD requires paired coordinates across the entire map.
exploratory_claims.limitations: The intervening backbone and both termini lack reference coordinates in the excerpt. The excerpt derives from the same experimental deposition used in the preceding study. Independent experimental corroboration requires a separate measurement of the same construct.

lead_interpretation.rationale: The matched_pairs list in agreement.json accounts for every Cα in the excerpt. Each paired residue has the same identity in the specimen sequence and both coordinate files. Every missing pair has a predicted Cα and lacks its reference Cα. The original coordinate rows and map confirm the inventory's coverage finding.

handoffs.rationale: Keep the preceding study’s workflow running. The independent inventory and the original coordinate rows identify five eligible chain A sites in specimen numbering: Ile2, Thr23, Arg45, Val68 and Gly90. The queued fit will test whether each has a predicted counterpart and measure their Cα RMSD. The excerpt comes from the same 1QYS deposition used previously. Its 87 missing reference positions leave whole-specimen agreement unresolved regardless of the five-site RMSD.

Keep the preceding study’s mapped Cα comparison and review its agreement.json when delivered. The fresh AlphaFold model has one identity-matched chain A Cα for each reference site at specimen positions 2, 23, 45, 68 and 90. The coordinate rows and independent inventory agree that the excerpt leaves 87 mapped positions unobserved. The pending fit can quantify the discrepancy at the five paired sites. Assessing the remaining positions requires additional reference coordinates.
